Navigation

Khoảng cách còn lại

The remaining distance to a specified point along the planned route, as displayed on the flight management system or requested by ATC for position reports.

Quick answer: The remaining distance to a specified point along the planned route, as displayed on the flight management system or requested by ATC for position reports.
